workarounds.symptom: [PYSEC-2026-1377] Flask uses fallback key instead of current signing key (Affects flask < 3.1.1)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade flask to patched release >= 3.1.1: pip install --upgrade 'flask>=3.1.1' (Advisory: PYSEC-2026-1377)
